title: feat(nm2oricycl3z): cyclic lex-largest det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on three-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Cyclic frame F=(m,o_next,o_prev) with LEX-LARGEST tie-break on the 3-axis-opposite NEAR seed (3rd pair at (2,0,0)/(2,1,0)), z-probes: Orient -1,+1,+1,-1 -> fail/fail while cover and split both HOLD reverse and face. Recomputed independently: exact. Its cell is the one the near third pair perturbs (that pair's front reaches (1,0,0),(1,1,0) at tick 1 and strips -e_3 from O(B),O(D)); the same cell under lex-smallest (#7483) gives hold/hold, so this member's verdict pair is a tie-break artifact.
